primary_domains.theme_name: The ability to be; to endure/uphold. (FM of World/Reality)
primary_domains.justification_quote: The following table: "Noetic content: 1. TRUE (reality)" and "Motivation: Will to be" and "Mode of experience: can"

sub_themes.justification_quote: Noetic content: 1. TRUE (reality)
This demands three things: protection, space and support.
My active part in this fundamental condition of being there is to accept the positive sides and to endure the negative ones.

sub_themes.concept: Fundamental Trust, Confidence in Self, Faith
sub_themes.justification_quote: The sum of these experiences of trust is the fundamental trust, the trust in whatever I feel as being the last support in my life.
If this is not the case, the result will be restlessness, insecurity and fear.
Each fundamental motivation has four types of coping reactions: the basic reaction type - here this would be avoidance or flight
the paradoxical reaction type or activism - here this would be overactivity like fighting bacteria by compulsive washing
the third type of coping reaction is a specific aggression...- here it would be a destructive aggression such as hate

sub_themes.concept: Denial or Pretending to be Non-Existent
sub_themes.justification_quote: the last type of coping reaction is a reflex of freezing, of death imitation with paralysis - here denial or pretending to be non-existent.

primary_domains.theme_name: The ability to feel value/life. (FM of Life/Value)
primary_domains.existential_question: I am alive - do I like this fact? Is it good to be there?
primary_domains.justification_question_quote: I am alive - do I like this fact? Is it good to be there?
primary_domains.justification_quote: The following table: "Noetic content: 2. ATTRACTIVE (value)" and "Motivation: Will to value" and "Mode of experience: like"

sub_themes.justification_quote: Noetic content: 2. ATTRACTIVE (value)
In order to seize my life, to love it, I need three things: relationship, time and closeness.

sub_themes.concept: Seizing Life / Consent to Being Touched
sub_themes.justification_quote: If life is to make me move freely, my consent to being touched is necessary.

sub_themes.concept: Fundamental Value, Harmony, Sense of Depth of Life
sub_themes.justification_quote: These experiences form the fundamental value, the most profound feeling for the value of life.
If relationships, closeness and time are lacking, longing will arise, then coldness and finally depression.
The basic coping reaction on this level is regression.
The activism here is overprotection or achievement, typical forms of combating evil

sub_themes.concept: Fury or Rage (to obtain or improve relationship)
sub_themes.justification_quote: the typical aggression is fury, rage which does not lead to destruction, but wants to agitate the other person with the impulse to obtain or to improve the relationship.
Resignation reaction of feigned death paralyzed half-way.

primary_domains.theme_name: The ability to be oneself; to be just. (FM of Self/Justice)
primary_domains.existential_question: I am myself - may I be like this?
primary_domains.justification_question_quote: I am myself - may I be like this?
primary_domains.justification_quote: The following table: "Noetic content: 3. RIGHT (relations)" and "Motivation: Will to the right" and "Mode of experience: may"

sub_themes.justification_quote: Noetic content: 3. RIGHT (relations)
In order to succeed here, it is necessary to have experienced three things: attention, justice and appreciation.

sub_themes.concept: Saying 'Yes to myself' through Encounter and Regret (Delimitation)
sub_themes.justification_quote: I also have to say "yes to myself". This requires again my active participation: to look at other people, to encounter them and, at the same time, to delimitate myself and to stand by my own, but to refuse whatever does not correspond to myself. Encounter and regret are the two means by which we can live our authenticity without ending up in solitude.
The sum of these experiences builds one's own worth, the profoundest worth of what identifies my own self at its core: the self-esteem.

sub_themes.concept: Solitude, Hysteria, Need to Hide behind Shame, Loneliness
sub_themes.justification_quote: If these experiences are missing, solitude will be the result, hysteria as well as a need to hide behind the shame.
The coping reactions of this motivation are: distancing oneself as the basic reaction
stubborn insistence and leading a functional life as form of activism.
The typical aggressive reaction consists in indignation, annoyance anger, reproach.

sub_themes.concept: Dissociation (of bodily integrity), Dividing and Splitting (of emotion and cognition)
sub_themes.justification_quote: The freezing type of reaction at this level are dissociation of the bodily integrity, dividing and splitting of emotion and cognition.

primary_domains.theme_name: The ability to do good; to be creative/meaning. (FM of Meaning/Future)
primary_domains.existential_question: I am there - for what is it good?
primary_domains.justification_question_quote: I am there - for what is it good?
primary_domains.justification_quote: The following table: "Noetic content: 4. MEANING" and "Motivation: Will to act/Will to meaning" and "Mode of experience: should/want"

sub_themes.justification_quote: Noetic content: 4. MEANING (commitment)

sub_themes.concept: A Field of Activity, A Structural Context, A Value to be Realized in the Future
sub_themes.justification_quote: For this three things are needed: a field of activity, a structural context and a value to be realized in the future.

sub_themes.concept: The Most Valuable, Realistic Possibility in the Given Situation
sub_themes.justification_quote: We define meaning as "the most valuable, realistic possibility of the given situation, for which I feel I should decide myself".

sub_themes.concept: Bringing Self into Correspondence with the Situation (Phenomenological Attitude)
sub_themes.justification_quote: My active part in this attitude of openness is to bring myself into correspondence with the situation, to examine whether what I am doing is really a good thing: for others, for myself, for the future, for my environment.

sub_themes.concept: Sense of Fulfillment, Dedication, Action, Religious Belief
sub_themes.justification_quote: The sum of these experiences add up to the meaning of life and leads to a sense of fulfillment.

sub_themes.concept: Feeling of Emptiness, Frustration, Despair, Addiction, Absurdity
sub_themes.justification_quote: If this is not the case, the result will be a feeling of emptiness, frustration, even despair and frequently addiction.

If man fails systematically to reach meaning, his coping reactions will be a provisional attitude towards life as basic reaction, together with a 'planless, day-to-day attitude toward life' and 'collective thinking' (Frankl 1973, XVI)
idealisation and fanaticism as main forms of activism
aggressive games and cynicism.

sub_themes.concept: Fatalism, Loss of Interest, Apathy, Nihilism
sub_themes.justification_quote: Fatalism (Frankl 1973, XVI), loss of interest, apathy and probably nihilism can be seen as forms of freezing reactions.
